claims: NASA's Artemis II mission is scheduled to launch on Wednesday, April 1, 2026.
NASA's Artemis II mission is scheduled to launch at 6:24 p.m. EDT.
NASA's Artemis II mission is scheduled to launch from Launch Pad 39B at the Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The Artemis II launch has a two-hour window.
Backup opportunities for the Artemis II launch are available through April 6, 2026 if needed.
Live coverage of the Artemis II launch is available on NASA's YouTube channel.
Live coverage of the Artemis II launch is available on NASA TV.
Official coverage of the Artemis II launch starts around 12:50 p.m. EDT.
NASA's Artemis II mission is the first crewed flight of the SLS rocket.
NASA's Artemis II mission is the first crewed flight of the Orion capsule.
NASA's Artemis II mission sends four astronauts on a 10-day journey around the moon
